title: CIF-Bench: A Chinese Instruction-Following Benchmark for Evaluating the Generalizability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the zero-shot instruction-following performance of LLMs on newly curated native Chinese tasks versus existing tasks translated from English to measure the performance gap caused by English-dominant pre-training corpora.

Evaluating models on 18 designated "Chinese Culture" tasks to test their understanding of nuances, idioms, and context unique to Chinese history, society, and language, which are often missed by Western-centric models.

Measuring the performance drop when evaluating models on a private split of unseen, newly annotated tasks compared to a public split of translated tasks likely scraped from the internet, explicitly quantifying score inflation from data leakage.

Assessing the model's capacity to identify and mitigate harmful or stereotypical content via specific benchmark tasks included in the suite, such as 'Stereotype Detection', 'Toxic Language Detection', and 'Bias Detoxication'.
